newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan drops interest on forex certificates.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan drops interest on forex certificates.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Monday it has cut interest rates on five-year maturity Deutsche mark and Japanese yen bearer certificates.
The bank said the rate for the mark certificate was slashed to 7.50 percent per annum from 7.75 percent fixed last month. Interest on yen certificate was cut to 4.25 percent from 4.50 percent.
Interest on dollar and pound sterling certificates were unchanged at nine percent and 9.75 percent respectively, the bank said. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
